title: IAM OIDC — CI → AWS without credentials
description: GitLab CI assumes an AWS IAM role via OIDC federation. No static keys, scoped per environment tier.

title: EKS Karpenter Provisioner
description: Karpenter auto-selects optimal instance types. Idle clusters cost $0 — ephemeral nodes self-destroy.
code:
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1beta1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: platformbox-default
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      requirements:
        - key: kubernetes.io/arch
          operator: In
          values: [arm64]
        - key: karpenter.sh/capacity-type
          operator: In
          values: [spot, on-demand]
  limits:
    cpu: "32"
    memory: 128Gi
  disruption:
    consolidationPolicy: WhenUnderutilized
    consolidateAfter: 60s

title: Kyverno ClusterPolicy — immutable digests
description: Rejects any workload referencing mutable tags. Enforces SHA256 digests; does not warn.
code:
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: block-latest-tag
spec:
  validationFailureAction: Enforce
  background: false
  rules:
    - name: validate-image-digest
      match:
        any:
          - resources:
              kinds: [Pod, Deployment, StatefulSet]
      validate:
        message: "Use a SHA256 digest, not a mutable tag."
        pattern:
          spec:
            containers:
              - image: "*@sha256:*"

title: CI/CD Golden Path — .gitlab-ci.yml
description: Standard pipeline: lint, test, scan, build, promote through IAM-enforced staging gates.
code:
stages:
  - test
  - scan
  - build
  - deploy-qa
  - deploy-uat
  - deploy-prod

lint:
  stage: test
  image: golangci/golangci-lint:v1.59-alpine
  script: golangci-lint run --timeout 5m ./...

unit:
  stage: test
  image: golang:1.22-alpine
  script: go test -count=1 -race -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...

build:
  stage: build
  image: docker:25-dind
  script: docker build -t $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA . && docker push $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA

deploy-uat:
  stage: deploy-uat
  script: terraform apply -auto-approve
  when: manual

deploy-prod:
  stage: deploy-prod
  script: terraform apply -auto-approve
  when: manual
  needs: [deploy-uat]

title: ArgoCD GitOps Application — reconcile, don't push
description: The cluster reconciles to the state declared in Git. No direct kubectl, no drift.
code:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: demo-service-prod
  namespace: argocd
spec:
  project: platformbox-production
  source:
    repoURL: https://gitlab.com/platform-box-group/demo-service.git
    targetRevision: main
    path: environments/production
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: production
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: true
      selfHeal: true
    retry:
      limit: 3
      backoff:
        duration: 5s
        factor: 2
        maxDuration: 3m
